messages.subject: set encoding in includeHTML
parts:
I'd like to use Word to create an html document for use in shiny. But at least on a Mac, Word's html output includes some encoding that shiny doesn't like. I can manually set the encoding to UTF-8 (which doesn't seem to affect the output) with a text  editor but would like to do that as part of a script. 

I thought maybe includeHTML would have an encoding = option, but the following

includeHTML("www/affordabilityText.html", encoding = "UTF-8")

returned an unused argument message.

Eventually, I'll probably have to switch to some kind of html editing program, or code it directly in the html options in shiny, but for now Word is easy and Word documents can be edited by lots of people on the project, which is a good thing.

Suggestions?

Thanks,
Jerry
